narrative.human_title: CoroCoro July 1999 Marill: the blue future peeking through
narrative.why_it_matters: Marill is one of those cards where the history is almost louder than the attack text. In 1999, the little blue shape carried rumor, preview energy, and second-generation curiosity. CoroCoro could place it into a magazine issue and make the future feel hand-held before Neo-era binders and English Wizards memories rewrote the context. This row is not simply Marill; it is source index 108, June 1999, Japanese Original Series layout, Sugimori character clarity, and the soft thrill of seeing the next world arrive early.

narrative.human_title: Marill 108: the blue rumor before the binder settled
narrative.why_it_matters: Marill has that particular late-1990s electricity: small, round, blue, rumored, and somehow bigger than its stats. In this row it belongs to CoroCoro before it belongs to the neat English Wizards/Neo memory. That is why the route matters. The card is a magazine-handled preview of the next world, with Sugimori clarity and Japanese Original Series structure holding the object in place before the name Marill, or the old Pikablu echo, makes an agent jump too fast.
